full_text: Hello. Hello. Aap kahan se ho? Aap kahan se ho? Main Agra se hoon. Aap kahan se? Agra. Agra? Haan. Agra ka Taj Mahal bolte ho? Haan, wahi to. Main Gujarat se hoon, Surat se. Kya karte ho aap? Hmm? Kya karte ho? Kya bol rahi ho? Kya karte ho aap? Main time job karta hoon. Aap kya karti ho? Main kuch nahi, ghar pe rehti hoon. Dosti karoge kya? Kya? Dosti karoge kya?
